svg.title: 01 · High-Level Enterprise Architecture
svg.desc: Payer and payee FSPs connect through Mojaloop Connectors to the Hub API edge. Inside the Hub, Kafka links the API services to the central ledger and settlement; MySQL, MongoDB and Redis hold state. Hub operations, monitoring, the finance portal, test tooling and the runtime platform are shown below.
svg.text: Participants, the Mojaloop Hub, operations and the runtime platform, as deployed and configured by this repository
